subject: Post-call: NovaBank procurement discovery & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@novabank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call: NovaBank procurement discovery & next steps

Hi Sofia — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call recap (high level):
- Primary use case: real-time fraud scoring and account support prompts (customer service) across US region.
- Expected Q1 ramp: ~50k requests/day initially, growing to 250k/day in year one (burst to 500k/day for peak periods).
- Decision criteria: latency under 300ms p50 for common prompts, SOC2/compliance checklist, predictable unit economics (cost per 1k tokens).

Stakeholder map (as discussed):
- Economic buyer: Sofia Alvarez (Head of Payments) — commercial/contract signoff
- Procurement lead: Jordan Hayes (Procurement) — PO, vendor onboarding
- Security: Tara Lin (Information Security) — questionnaire & SOC2
- POC/technical: Miguel Santos (Platform Eng) — integration and perf testing

Open asks / next steps for NovaBank:
1) Can you confirm the procurement process and typical PO timeline (we discussed Net30 + PO requirement)?
2) Who should we send vendor onboarding forms and what remit/address should appear on the invoice?
3) Any additional security artifacts needed beyond SOC2 (e.g., penetration test report)?

We attached the vendor_onboarding_questionnaire.xlsx and a first-draft Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf for your review. Neha (cc'd) will follow up on billing and SOC2 details. Rishi will handle pricing/contract follow-ups.

Proposed timeline: if PO and onboarding move in parallel with technical kickoff, we can target a pilot in mid-Jan.

Happy to hop on a short sync with Jordan/Tara if that helps — let me know available windows.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0122
https://redwood.com

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_questionnaire.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf

From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@novabank.com>

Cc: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@novabank.com>, procurement@novabank.com
Date: 2026-12-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: NovaBank procurement discovery & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and materials. A few quick items from procurement/security side: 

1) Procurement process: we require a completed vendor onboarding questionnaire (attached) + W-9 + insurance cert for vendors. Typical internal approval window is ~7-10 business days once all docs are in. PO issuance is contingent on commercial review and security signoff.
2) Billing / invoice details: invoices should be addressed to "NovaBank, Attn: Accounts Payable" — remit to: 123 Finance Ave, Suite 400, New York, NY 10005. We can accept emailed invoices to ap@novabank.com.
3) Payment terms: Net30 is standard; confirm on your side.
4) Security artifacts: Tara will need the SOC2 report (Type II) and our security team may request an on-demand pen test summary for the pilot.

I can take the onboarding questionnaire and route to Jordan and Tara. Jordan — looping you for PO cadence and next steps.

Sofia Alvarez
Head of Payments | NovaBank
sofia.alvarez@novabank.com
